# CodeSee

> > CodeSee provides AI-powered code visualization and understanding tools for developers, featuring CodeSee Maps and Service Maps to improve codebase visibility, onboarding, refactoring, and team collaboration.

CodeSee helps engineering teams understand complex codebases through automated visual maps and documentation. The platform integrates with GitHub and tools like Datadog to provide code visibility from day zero through enterprise-scale microservices architectures.

## Key Topics

- CodeSee Maps
- Code Visibility
- Codebase Visualization
- Developer Onboarding
- Code Automation

- Microservices
- AI Code Understanding

## Core Platform & Solutions

- [[Enterprise 2] CodeSee Service Maps - Landing Page Copy](https://www.codesee.io/enterprise-2-codesee-service-maps-landing-page-copy): Enterprise Service Maps: microservices visualization with Datadog integration
- [AI Code Understanding | CodeSee](https://www.codesee.io/ai): AI-powered code understanding for legacy codebases and analysis
- [Code Automation](https://www.codesee.io/code-automation): Workflow automation for code review and pull request best practices
- [CodeSee - General SaaS](https://www.codesee.io/saas): CodeSee platform for SaaS companies: code visibility and collaboration
- [CodeSee - Chief Technical Officers](https://www.codesee.io/cto): CodeSee solutions for CTOs: codebase visualization and automated docs
